Bash(gh pr create --title "fix(vector-ui): re-disable backfill button during active jobs" --body "$(cat <<''EOF''
## Summary
Fixes the Vector Status backfill button to correctly disable while jobs are running, preventing duplicate enqueues.

## Changes
- ✅ Added `queueCounts` parameter to `BackfillButton` component  
- ✅ Implemented `queueCounts.running > 0` check in disabled state logic
- ✅ Extracted `getBackfillDisabledState` to `backfill-utils.ts` for better testability
- ✅ Added 13 comprehensive unit tests covering all disabled state scenarios
- ✅ All existing tests pass (48 total in vector-management package)

## Test Plan
- [x] Unit tests: 13 new tests for `getBackfillDisabledState` covering:
  - No active set selected
  - Database not ready
  - Backfilling in progress
  - Jobs currently running (single and multiple)
  - Web worker not running
  - Valid enabled states
  - Correct priority order of checks
- [x] Integration tests: All 48 tests in @brainstrike/vector-management pass
- [x] Full test suite: All monorepo tests pass
- [x] Linting: Biome checks pass

## Technical Details
The backfill button''s disabled state now correctly checks `queueCounts.running > 0` before allowing new backfill operations. This prevents race conditions and duplicate job enqueueing when the worker is actively processing embeddings.

Priority order of disabled checks:
1. No active embedding set → "Select an active embedding set"
2. Database not ready → "Database not ready yet"
3. Backfilling in progress → "Backfilling in progress"
4. **Jobs running** → "Jobs are currently running – wait for completion" ⬅️ NEW
5. Web + worker not running → "Start worker to enable backfill on Web"

Resolves brainstrike-34

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
)")
